vit.d: A Transformer that reads an image as a sequence of patches: each patch becomes a vector through a linear projection, and bidirectional attention blocks + MLP mix the information among them. It is the basis of the vision towers in GLM (24 blocks), Qwen (27) and DeepSeek Vision-Exp (32).

patch-visual.d: A small square of \(p\times p\) pixels (14 in DeepSeek and GLM, 16 in Qwen), sometimes spanning 2 frames in time, flattened into \(3p^2 T_p\) numbers and projected by \(W_E\). Equivalent to a convolution with kernel and stride \(p\).

torre-visual.d: The image encoder of a multimodal LLM: patch embedding + ViT blocks + final normalization. Small (~0.5 B parameters in all three recipes) and kept in BF16; it only runs during the prefill of image tokens.

rope-2d.d: An extension of RoPE to grids: half of the dimension pairs rotate with the patch's row \(h\) and the other half with its column \(w\), so \(q\cdot k\) depends on \((\Delta h, \Delta w)\). In DeepSeek's ViT, \(\Theta = 10{,}000\) and 16 frequencies per axis.

merger-visual.d: The translator between the tower and the LLM: it gathers \(k\times k\) neighboring patches (2×2 in GLM and Qwen, 3×3 in DeepSeek), concatenates the vectors (space-to-depth) and projects them through a small MLP to the LLM's width (4096 or 2560). It divides the number of tokens by \(k^2\).

placeholder-de-imagem.d: A special token that marks where the image goes in the prompt (<|image|> 154854 in GLM, <|image_pad|> 248056 in Qwen, <｜deepseek_image｜> 129264 in DeepSeek). The processor expands it into N copies, and the copies' embeddings are swapped for the visual vectors.

masked-scatter.d: The operation that writes the tower's vectors, in order, into the rows of the embedding tensor marked as placeholders. In vLLM it is the final step of embed_input_ids for multimodal models.

layout-n.d: The order in which DeepSeek writes an image's tokens: rows in pairs traversed column by column (4 consecutive tokens form a 2×2 square), one newline token per row, an alignment pad, IMAGE_START and IMAGE_END.

compress-pad.d: Pad tokens (\(3 - s \bmod 4\)) inserted before IMAGE_START so that the image body starts at a position that is a multiple of 4, matching (interpretation) the C4 KV compression. It makes the block vary from 122 to 125 tokens depending on the position \(s\).

temporal-patch.d: temporal_patch_size = 2 in GLM and Qwen: two consecutive frames form a 3D patch (a 2×p×p Conv3d). A video becomes \(\text{grid}_t\) = frames/2 groups of tokens, and a still image is duplicated in time.

data-url.d: A URL that carries its own bytes: data:image/jpeg;base64,…. It is the way to send images through the API without the server downloading anything or reading the local disk.

processador-multimodal.d: vLLM's CPU stage that decodes the media, resizes it to the token budget, normalizes it, cuts it into patches, expands the placeholders and computes the content hash. Each model registers its own (DeepSeek got one through the Vision-Exp hotfix).

mm-hash.d: The identity of a media item computed from its content (bytes and processor parameters). It serves as the key for the processor cache, the encoder cache and the prefix caching blocks. In DeepSeek, it had to include the block's number of tokens (#172).

cache-do-processador.d: A host-RAM cache of already processed media (--mm-processor-cache-gb, 4 GiB by default) that avoids reprocessing images resent by stateless clients. On unified memory, it comes out of the model's memory; GLM uses 1 GiB.

encoder-cache.d: The GPU area where vLLM keeps the vision tower's outputs until the prefill has consumed every position of the image, possibly across several chunked prefill steps. According to the GLM recipe, it is the size of max_num_batched_tokens (7,168).

max-image-tokens.d: The ceiling on LLM tokens per image in GLM's processor (--mm-processor-kwargs). The checkpoint asks for 8,000; the recipe uses 2,048 because 8,000 exceeds the encoder cache and because videos broken into frames blew up the encode (236,544 tokens).

skip-mm-profiling.d: Skips the boot profile that pushes fake maximum-size media through the tower to reserve activation memory. It avoids OOM on unified memory (GLM), but nothing is reserved for vision, and the per-request limits become the only protection.

limit-mm-per-prompt.d: The maximum number of media items per request ({"image":48,"video":1} in GLM, {"image":8} in DeepSeek). It is per-request validation: above it the API returns an error. Stateless clients resend the history, so a session can get “poisoned” once it passes the ceiling.

mm-encoder-tp-mode.d: How the vision tower behaves under tensor parallel: weights (default) slices the matrices across the GPUs; data replicates the tower and splits the images. Qwen uses data because 4304/2 = 2152 is not a multiple of 16; GLM uses data at TP=3.

epd.d: A mode in which vLLM splits encode, prefill and decode into different instances; the encode instance (the encoder cache producer) publishes embeddings instead of sampling tokens. DeepSeek's hotfix #109 fixes the phantom token 0 and the loop in those steps.

sidecar-de-visao.d: A coupled architecture: a second model (a VLM) describes the images in text for a text-only LLM. In the DeepSeek recipe it was the Qwen3-VL-4B AWQ + MCP of the text-only era (it coexisted with the MoonViT lane, which was deleted earlier), removed on 2026-08-31 in favor of Vision-Exp's native tower; it meant running at 0.80 util with the KV split between two models.

roteamento-por-modalidade.d: Routing in which image tokens follow their own rules: in DeepSeek Vision-Exp, top6(s + bias_vl) in every layer and no hash table in layers 0–2. It keeps all the placeholders (same id) from landing on the same experts.

orcamento-visual-por-requisicao.d: A token ceiling that all the images (or all the clips) of a request share, on top of the per-item ceiling. In GLM's TensorFold lane (through v1.10): 16,384 tokens for images and 32,768 for clips, and each image gets \(\max(16, \min(2048, \lfloor 16384/n \rfloor))\), 327 with 50. It keeps the worst-case encode constant, at the cost of resolution when there are many images.
